title: Federal Register: Agency Information Collection Activities, CMS-855I Medicare Enrollment Application for Physician and Non-Physician Practitioners (30-day notice)

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
reliability: Government document; the agency both imposes the form and estimates its burden. Estimates are ex ante.
findings: CMS-855I (OMB control number 0938-1355) is the sole instrument CMS uses to enroll physicians and non-physician practitioners in Medicare; the notice describes it as the "first line defense" against illegitimate practitioners.
CMS states 813,975 respondents, 813,975 responses and 1,364,716 total annual hours for this collection.
limitations: The notice does not state hours per response; dividing gives about 1.7 hours per response, which is my arithmetic, not a CMS figure.
Covers Medicare enrollment only, not commercial payer credentialing or directory updates.
The supporting statement referred to in the notice was not read; agency burden estimates are not measured time.
